_comment: wp_vncorp — keyless Vietnamese business-registry lookup (tax code / MST, or a company name) against public mirrors. Every endpoint URL template, the fetch profile, and the Vietnamese-label -> canonical-field map live here (RULE 3) so a mirror going stale or a new label variant is a data edit, not a code change. `{query}` is URL-encoded by the caller before substitution. Nothing here is case data — these are public mirror hostnames and generic Vietnamese business-registry vocabulary.

settings._comment: The User-Agent is the shared Android default (wp_ua <- fetch_profile.json -> ua_pool); add a `ua` key here only to override it for this tool. timeout_seconds is the socket timeout per mirror fetch.

sources._comment: Public VN business-registry mirrors, queried in order. `mst_url` is used for a 10/13-digit tax-code (MST) query; `name_url` (falling back to `mst_url` if absent) is used for a company-name query. Each is a keyless HTML page — no account, no key. A source may add `listing` (same {card_start, fields} shape as reverse_sources) — its results page is cut into rows and the row whose tax code (or name) matches the query is followed to `detail_url` — and `page_fields` ({scope_start, scope_end, null_values, fields}) when its record page defeats the generic label_map parser. Probe 2026-11-08 (Android UA, direct): masothue.com answers a Cloudflare 'Just a moment' challenge and thuvienphapluat.vn a Cloudflare 'Attention Required' block (both reported as errors with `cf_retry`; `--solve-cf` retries via FlareSolverr / a Chromium render, which did not clear either from a datacenter egress); hsctvn.com redirects off-host to an unrelated shop (off-host guard -> error); doanhnghiep.biz answers — its `/tim-kiem?keyword=` path IGNORES the parameter and serves the newest-registrations list, so the working paths are the `/<MST>` record page and `/tim-kiem/?timkiem=`. thuvienphapluat.vn's search form (`timtheo` = ma-so-thue | ten-doanh-nghiep, `tukhoa` = query), listing rows (`tr.item_mst_o`) and record-page layout were read from Wayback captures of the same paths (2025-07 record page, 2026-10 listing), because the live site was walled from the probe egress.

listing._comment: A company-name query lands on a results list; the row whose name matches is followed to its record page. `listing_marker` (the results page title) decides list-vs-record, because a masothue RECORD page also carries data-prefetch rows (related companies).

cloakbrowser._comment: OPTIONAL --solve-cf step tried BEFORE FlareSolverr / render_cf (pip install cloakbrowser; licence via `cloakbrowser login` or CLOAKBROWSER_LICENSE_KEY in the gitignored .env). masothue answers a DIRECT /Search/ URL — even with the form's hidden token — with a DECOY: a different, freshly registered company. So a URL matching `search_url_re` is never navigated to: the `query_param` value is typed into `input_selector` on `home_url` and Enter pressed, then the page must leave the home URL within `result_timeout_ms`; any other URL (a record page) is opened directly in the same session. One headless, humanized session per run (free tier = 1 concurrent session). android_ua: true — live test 2026-11-08 with the module's Android Chrome UA on the page context still returned the correct record (tax code + title matched), so the project's Android-UA rule holds here.
cloakbrowser._egress_comment: use_process_proxy: false — live 2026-11-08 the process proxy pool's exit (a datacenter HTTP proxy) kept CloakBrowser on the 'Just a moment' interstitial (search box never appeared, 30 s timeout), while a direct launch cleared it. So without an explicit --proxy the CloakBrowser step launches DIRECT (Chromium forced to --no-proxy-server, which it would otherwise read from HTTP(S)_PROXY); pass --proxy (e.g. a residential one) to route it, or set true to use the pool. The target is a public business registry, not the adversary's infrastructure.

page_fields.scope_end: THAY ĐỔI GẦN ĐÂY|DOANH NGHIỆP MỚI CẬP NHẬT
null_values: Thông tin không được công bố.

address.re: Địa chỉ trụ sở(?:\s*\(sau sáp nhập\))?:\s*([^\n]+)

value_trim._comment: Canonical field -> regexes (case-insensitive, dot-all) REMOVED from a parsed value, applied by every parser (label_map pairs, page_fields, reverse listings). A mirror's representative cell often carries a trailing 'Ngoài ra, <name> còn đại diện các doanh nghiệp…' list of the other companies that person represents (doanhnghiep.biz and masothue.com record pages); without the cut the name field reads as name + prose. That list is a separate lead, not part of the name.

label_map._comment: Vietnamese (accented and ASCII-folded) label variants -> canonical field name. wp_vncorp folds diacritics before comparing, so an accented label in real HTML still matches the ASCII variant listed here. Order is the field order in the tool's output.

reverse_sources._comment: REVERSE modes (`--by-phone`, `--by-person`): mirrors whose RESULTS LISTING can be searched by a contact phone or a legal-representative name, each with the regexes that cut one listing into records and read each record. `by_phone_url` / `by_person_url` take the URL-encoded query (`{query}`); a mirror without one is skipped for that mode. `card_start` is a regex on the raw HTML marking the start of each record. Each `fields` entry is {re, on}: `on: html` runs on the raw record HTML, `on: text` on the record with every tag turned into a newline, entities unescaped and NFC-normalised; group 1 is the value. `phones` may hold several numbers separated by `phone_split`; `*` marks mirror-masked digits. Probe 2026-11-08: infocom.vn indexes the registered contact phone (shown masked, last digits '*') but not the representative; doanhnghiep.biz has a dedicated representative search (`/nguoi-dai-dien/?name=`, accented input) and no phone index; tratencongty.com searches company names and shows the representative (tax code is an image, not parsed). masothue.com (Cloudflare challenge) and hsctvn.com (off-host redirect) are left out because neither answered a search.

reverse_detail._comment: The record page used to VERIFY a reverse-mode row by its tax code (MST): the listing masks or omits the phone, the record page carries it in full. `url` takes `{mst}`; fields are read with the same label_map as a forward lookup. `max_verify` caps record fetches per run.
reverse_detail.label: doanhnghiep.biz

reverse_settings._comment: max_rows caps rows kept per mirror listing. shared_phone_threshold: when this many DISTINCT companies list the same exact contact number it is flagged as a shared service number (accounting / registration agent), which is the common case and says nothing about who controls any one company. address_token_overlap is the share of the analyst's folded address tokens (length >= 2) that must appear in the record's address for an `address` corroboration. province_prefixes are folded administrative prefixes stripped from a `province` corroborator before matching.

reverse_caveats.by_phone: A company that lists this number as its registered contact is a LEAD, not an attribution: registration agents and accounting firms file their own number for many clients, and a masked-listing match is only consistent, not exact, until the record page confirms it.
reverse_caveats.by_person: Vietnamese personal names repeat at very high rates. A representative-name hit is a CANDIDATE homonym until a second datum (address, province, date of birth, phone) matches on the same record; even a linked row is a registry fact about that company, never an operator attribution on its own.
